exposure: birth weight group (extremely low birth weight vs. normal birth weight)
cohort: The study included 95 mature adults born with extremely low birth weight (under 1 kg) and 88 mature adults born with normal birth weight, all in their early 30s.
finding: Adults born with extremely low birth weight exhibited significantly lower grip strength compared to those born with normal birth weight, independent of sex, height, and lean mass index.
birth_weight: Under 1 kg (Extremely Low Birth Weight) and Normal Birth Weight (>1kg)
